Sandbox_foodWorks_EnableFoodInspection_t: Adds a read-only inventory action showing vanilla food, freshness, preservation, and nutrition state. It never changes the food item.
Sandbox_foodWorks_EnableFruitDryingPrevi: Shows local rack and apple prechecks. It cannot start drying, move items or prove server eligibility.
Sandbox_foodWorks_EnableFruitDrying_tool: Allows new server-owned apple-drying batches at native small-plant racks. Existing batches retain their saved settings and remain available when disabled.
Sandbox_foodWorks_FruitDryingHours_toolt: Loaded, observed game hours required for new batches. Integer 6–168, step 1; default 48. Unloaded racks and long observation gaps pause drying. No electricity, water or weather simulation is used.
Sandbox_foodWorks_FruitDryingShelfLifeMu: Integer 1–12, step 1; default 6. New batches scale both freshness thresholds and carried age together. Drying never resets age or adds calories. Existing batches keep their saved multiplier.
